protagonists: a handsome Asian young man and a cute Asian young woman with an hourglass body figure who are a couple, always together, interacting with each other or sharing an activity

instructions: Generate one original concept for a cute anime couple video.
Focus on ONE clear physical action or interaction between the couple.
The summary field CAN use character names Aden and Anna for readability.
The prompt field MUST NEVER use character names - describe each character visual appearance instead.
IMPORTANT: Each character has their OWN outfit. NEVER apply one character clothing to the other.
The handsome Asian young man always wears pants or shorts as bottom wear - vary the color and style.
The cute Asian young woman always has an hourglass body figure - always include it when describing her - and always wears a short miniskirt or short dress as bottom wear - vary the color and style.
Always describe her hourglass body figure, plus hair, top wear, and bottom wear for BOTH characters.
Keep the prompt concise and visual - describe what the camera sees.
Do NOT include music or audio instructions in the prompt field - visuals only.

boy.description: A handsome Asian young man. Always describe his hair, top wear, and bottom wear. Never use his name in generation prompts.
boy.default_outfit: handsome Asian young man, short black hair, dark blue shirt, black pants

girl.description: A cute Asian young woman with an hourglass body figure. Always describe her hourglass body figure, hair, top wear, and bottom wear (short miniskirt or short dress). Never use her name in generation prompts.
